title: Nannenthagano – Joshua Shaik Telugu Christian Lyrics
telugu: నీ ప్రేమ చాలు నాకు నా యేసయ్య
నా జీవ నావ నీవే నా యేసయ్య
నాలోని ఆశ నీవే – ఎదలోని ధ్యాస నీవే
english: Nee prema chaalu naaku naa yesayya
Naa jeeva naava neeve naa yesayya
Naaloni aasa neeve – yedhaloni dhyaasa neeve
translation: You have desired me so deeply,
You have been with me throughout my life.
You created me,
You forgave me,
Your love alone is enough for me, my Jesus.
What is there in this world? It is like a stormy sea before me,
But You are the boat of my life, my Jesus.
Even if the shore is far away,
Even if darkness surrounds me,
I have no fear as long as You are with me.
Even when storms arise, all authority belongs to You.
Each day I will praise and sing of Your grace.
My beloved Jesus, lead me like this always.
O God, I cannot imagine a life without You,
Not even for a single moment can I live without You.
You are the desire within me,
You are the focus of my heart.
This life is only for serving at Your feet.
Every part of me belongs to You, I will sing this in this world.
Until the very end, I will live as Your witness forever.
My beloved Jesus, have mercy on me and guide me.
intro: Nannenthagano is the latest Telugu Christian song written by Joshua Shaik, sung by Anand and music composed by Pranam Kamlakhar. This song was released on March 20, 2026, through Joshua Shaik Ministries YouTube Channel.
